title: Run a capital project
summary: Scope, bid, contract and supervise a roof, parking lot or renovation project and close it out.
outlineSteps: Confirm the component's condition and remaining life
Check the leases for who pays for the work
Check the loan for reserve draws and lender approval
Hire a designer or engineer to scope the work where needed
Write the scope and bid it to qualified contractors
Compare bids and sign the construction contract
Pull permits and schedule the work around tenants
Supervise progress and approve pay applications
Collect lien waivers with each payment
Close out with warranties and as-built records
